Pangoro

Fighting Dark

Kalos · Generation 6

Pangoro is a Fighting/Dark-type Daunting Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 2.1 m tall and weighs 136 kg. It evolves from Pancham. Its highest base stat is Attack (124), with a base stat total of 495.
